title: vapor-wares public arm mount map
description: The mount map is the source of truth; submodules are an artifact of the mounts.
invariant: Only public gitlinks and this contract live here.

defaults.branch: declared per mount, set to the remote's discovered default. Discovered, never assumed; declared so a remote changing its default fails loudly instead of silently moving us.
defaults.rationale: A public arm records public mounts at their recorded gitlink so a snapshot replays exactly. The gateway above floats.
